title: Piercing Frame Solo #001 (일반 가슴 컷 · P25 집중형 · 콘로우 · 체스트넛브라운 · 메이크업 화환화장 · 금속 은 · 재질 혼합 3종(석재+인어비늘+나비날개비늘) · 세로 띠 · 체형 작은 체구에 풍만한 가슴)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, bust shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head to just below her chest, the frame cutting off beneath the chest. Her face sits large and sharp in the upper half of the frame, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Ukrainian woman — fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain — a photograph of a real woman, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge silver segment ring hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide silver ear cuff, three smaller silver rings, two thick silver bars and a small silver stud up to the top; one small silver stud sits in the right ear; four thin silver bars pass through the outer half of the left eyebrow; two small silver rings pass through the left nostril and a thick silver septum ring hangs below the nose; a silver hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a silver snake-bite ring beside it and a small silver ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a silver Medusa stud sits above the lips; a silver labret stud and a small silver ring sit on the chin; three small silver studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small opals set into the metal. All jewelry is real silver, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: a petite frame with a surprisingly full bust.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin, covering every inch from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her body below the collarbones is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 33% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 78% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries solid polished black granite fused directly into her own form, fine natural speckled texture flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep charcoal-black granite surface with VIVID silver mineral fleck detail. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID PEARL scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID MAGENTA scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her chest, shoulders and arms, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it is the body treatment described above.

Pose: arms relaxed at her sides, shoulders level, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: pure pitch black background. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
